title: Sorting it out
description:
Write sorting and matching helpers:

```python
def leaderboard(players): ...      # players: list of {"name": ..., "score": ...}; score descending, then name ascending (case-insensitive)
def sort_versions(versions): ...   # ["1.10", "1.2", "1.9.1", "1.2.0"] -> numeric order; equal versions keep their order
def longest_words(text, n): ...    # the n longest distinct words (lower-cased), longest first, ties alphabetical
def describe(command): ...         # uses match (below)
```

`describe` returns: `"going <dir>"` for `go <dir>`; `"taking <a>, <b>"` for `take` followed by one or more items; `"bye"` for `quit` or `exit`; `"unknown"` otherwise (including `take` with no items). Words are separated by spaces.
hints: Compare versions as lists of numbers: `[1, 10] > [1, 9, 1]`. Trailing zeros removed, `1.2.0` and `1.2` become equal, and a stable sort keeps their order.
